Dmitri Mercer
dmitri.mercer@example.com | San Jose, CA
Dmitri Mercer has 7 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Northbeam Dynamics (2024-2026), where
they applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 82K
concurrent users. Before that, Backend Engineer at Sable Systems (2023-2024).
Before that, Software Engineer I at Nimbus Technologies (2019-2023). Education:
M.S. Computer Engineering, University of Minnesota, 2019; B.S. Computer
Engineering, University of Colorado Boulder, 2016. Core skills: PostgreSQL,
Docker, REST API design, AWS, Node.js.
